content.definition: Remember what matters to them, and prepare for it.
content.name: Thoughtful

ratings.0: Nothing in it touched on what matters to them
ratings.1: A small sign that I remembered
ratings.2: It clearly reflected what matters to them
ratings.3: It was shaped around what matters to them

parts.rubric: Did this event show that I remembered what matters to them?

ratings.1: It was for them, but generic
ratings.2: It was for them, and fit what matters to them
ratings.3: It was carefully made around what matters to them

parts.rubric: Was this preparation for them, built on what matters to them?

content.definition: Do what I said I would, and keep contact going -- reliable to myself too.
content.name: Reliable

content.definition: Make something together with them (making something alone is taking care of myself).
content.name: Creative

ratings.1: We shared ideas, but made nothing

content.definition: Share new experiences with them: new activities, new places.

ratings.0: The activity and place were routine

ratings.2: The activity or the place were new
ratings.3: Both the activity and place were new, or the event was otherwise adventurous

parts.rubric: Was this activity or place new?

content.definition: Make an effort for them, including the attention I give them: the follow-through of thoughtfulness.

ratings.0: Little effort, or my attention was elsewhere
